shots.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side. A woman in a purple shirt sits in the screen-side window seat and opens the consultation regarding the case, while a man in a green shirt sits in the screen-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the glass-door end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a red shirt enters and sits in the door-side window seat. A woman in a purple shirt invites her to assist with the account.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the walkway side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in a purple shirt summarizes the details of the case.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the presentation-screen end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the glass door, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.
